title: Settings title line — choose where it reaches full strength

steps.path: Where the header line reaches full strength
steps.hint: Look just beneath Settings, then scroll inside each drawer and watch the line meet the fading content. Scroll outside it to reach the next version. Switch themes above.
steps.headline: Which line taper works with your selected scroll fade?
steps.risk: Review-only Settings comparison. The fade stays at your selected steady 42px depth and 4% side taper in every pane; only the header line changes. A Settings choice does not approve the wording of an app-wide rule, changes to dialogs, or production styling.

variants.label: Quick ends
variants.summary: Line reaches full strength 8% in from either side: mostly solid, with short tapered ends.

variants.label: Moderate ends
variants.summary: Line reaches full strength 20% in from either side. This was held constant during the fade tests.

variants.label: Gradual ends
variants.summary: Line reaches full strength 32% in from either side: a shorter solid middle.
